description: A form that draws or grows with p: a bar or rule (grow-x, grow-y), a disc (scale), a ring that sweeps round like a progress dial (sweep), or a fade; solid or a two-colour gradient at an angle, with rounded corners, and an optional heavy blur that makes it a soft glow behind everything. Fills its placed box, or w/h px. Plain HTML and CSS, no script: it moves with the --p custom property that a motion_timeline p track sets, and standalone it renders its final state.
